name: automated-qa-system
description: Convenience scripts. Real deps live in web/ and runner/.

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix runner install && npm --prefix web exec -- prisma migrate deploy --schema web/prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix runner exec -- playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.migrate: npm --prefix web exec -- prisma migrate deploy --schema web/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix runner run typecheck
